description: This Java class configures Spring Security to permit unauthenticated access to Swagger UI endpoints and API documentation. It extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter and overrides the configure method to set security rules, including disabling CSRF and enabling CORS.

classes.name: SecurityPermitSwaggerConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class that allows public access to Swagger UI, API docs, and preflight CORS requests. It disables CSRF protection and applies high precedence in security filter chain.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter's configure method to set security rules permitting access to Swagger-related endpoints and configuring CORS and CSRF settings.
